name: B.O.O. Squad
detailed_description:
The most underqualified, overconfident ghost-hunting startup in the business.

Grab your gear, wrangle your friends (or unlucky coworkers), and step into the haunted world of B.O.O. Squad — a co-op multiplayer horror-comedy where chaos is expected, and competence is… optional.

🛠️ About the Game

Welcome to B.O.O. Squad, where you and your friends join a janky paranormal startup using highly questionable ghost-hunting tech to cleanse cursed locations. The job? Capture spirits, survive the night, and maybe, just maybe, avoid being possessed by a haunted office chair.

Expect bizarre tools, spooky encounters, and a lot of accidental betrayal.

🚨 Key Features

👥 Online Co-op

Team up with friends or randoms to face ghostly threats together. Work as a team... or totally mess it up. (Pro tip: don’t split up.)

🏚️ Randomised Hauntings

Each job is different, with unique ghost behaviours, unpredictable environments, and plenty of scream-and-laugh moments.

👻 Eerie Yet Adorable Design

Suit up as a chunky, glowing-eyed ghostbuster. Customise your character with different suits, colours, and gear loadouts.

📈 Startup Progression System

Upgrade your gear, unlock cursed tech, and rise through the haunted startup to become the least terrible ghost hunters around.

🎥 Streamer & Clip Friendly

Screams, fails, jumpscares, and betrayals — pure chaos made for sharing.

You’re not scared.
You’re trained.
...Sort of.

Welcome to the job. Welcome to B.O.O. Squad.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7, 8, 10, 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660, 2 GB or AMD equivalent
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS *: Windows 7, 8, 10, 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060, 3 GB or AMD equivalent
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
